title: Reproduction package: prompt prefixes as hidden-state initialization in large language models
description:
Code and summary data that regenerate every figure and table of a manuscript examining how zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt prefixes shape the hidden-state trajectories of large language models (target journal: Patterns, Cell Press).

The record contains the analysis and plotting code, the summary data underlying each figure and table, and the per-experiment documentation that maps every claim to its supporting file. Large raw inference artifacts (292 MB OpenCompass logs, the 104 MB term-first group48 archive, 55 MB packaged AIME 2024 runs) and the rendered figures are archived in a separate Zenodo deposit.

Code is released under the MIT license; data and figures under CC BY 4.0. Third-party benchmark datasets (GSM8K, AIME 2024, MMLU, CMMLU, HumanEval) are not redistributed; only derived summary statistics and prompts are included.
